[57:03.300 --> 57:04.600]  Let's say a two-by-two grid.
[57:05.280 --> 57:09.980]  In a perfect Latin square, every row and every column contains exactly the same set of elements,
[57:10.120 --> 57:14.580]  but no element ever repeats in the same row or column, like a Sudoku puzzle.
[57:15.240 --> 57:17.580]  Okay, a perfectly symmetrical grid of information.

[57:20.160 --> 57:22.020]  The author took the phrase bismillah,

[57:35.360 --> 57:38.380]  they form a perfect Kline four-group Latin square.
[57:39.060 --> 57:44.300]  The phonetic heaviness and lightness balance each other out in a perfect mathematically symmetrical grid.
